quote_zh: Hopper 架构 H100 已经全面投产，并将在 2022 年下半年（年底前）开始向全球客户交付。
quote_en: Hopper H100 is in full production now and will begin shipping to customers across the world in Q3/Q4 2022.

quote_zh: Grace Hopper 超级芯片（GH200）已进入全面量产，搭载该芯片的系统将在 2023 年下半年上市交付。
quote_en: Grace Hopper Superchip is in full production and systems will be available in the second half of 2023.

quote_zh: 搭载 HBM3e 显存的 NVIDIA H200 将于 2024 年第二季度开始出货交付。
quote_en: H200 with HBM3e will begin shipping in the second quarter of 2024.

quote_zh: 基于 Blackwell 架构的产品将在今年（2024 年）晚些时候由合作伙伴推出，并在第四季度实现大规模量产并形成数十亿美元营收。
quote_en: Blackwell-based products will be available from partners starting later this year (2024), with production ramping in Q4.

quote_zh: 我们的架构更新进入「一年一代」节奏：在 Blackwell 之后，Blackwell Ultra（B300 系列）将在 2025 年下半年推出并交付。
quote_en: We are on a one-year rhythm. After Blackwell, Blackwell Ultra will arrive in 2025.

quote_zh: 搭载 GB10 Grace Blackwell 超级芯片的个人桌面 AI 超级计算机 Project DIGITS（后定名 DGX Spark）将于 2025 年 5 月上市开售，起售价 3000 美元。
quote_en: Project DIGITS (DGX Spark), the personal AI supercomputer with GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, will be available in May 2025 starting at $3,000.

quote_zh: 采用 Blackwell 架构的 GeForce RTX 5090 与 RTX 5080 将于 2025 年 1 月 30 日正式上市开售。
quote_en: GeForce RTX 5090 and RTX 5080 powered by NVIDIA Blackwell will be available on January 30, 2025.

quote_zh: 我们在 Blackwell 之后的下一代平台名为 Vera Rubin，搭载 HBM4 显存与 Vera CPU，将在 2026 年下半年推出。
quote_en: Our next-generation platform after Blackwell is called Rubin, featuring HBM4 and Vera CPU, arriving in 2026.

quote_zh: 如果我们将 AGI 定义为能以媲美人类的水平通过人类测试的软件……那么在五年内（2029 年 3 月前），AI 将通过你摆在它面前的每一项人类测试。
quote_en: If we define AGI as software that can pass human tests competitively with humans... within five years (by 2029), AI will pass every single test you can put in front of it.

quote_zh: 通用人形机器人的「ChatGPT 时刻」即将到来，未来 2—3 年内将迎来人形机器人在制造业的规模化部署突破。
quote_en: The ChatGPT moment for general robotics is just around the corner.

quote_zh: GPT-4 会在某个时间点推出，前提是我们确信能够安全、负责任地发布（2023 年初访谈预示近期发布）。
quote_en: GPT-4 will come out at some point, when we are confident we can do it safely and responsibly.

quote_zh: 我们目前没有在训练 GPT-5，并且在未来一段时间内（至少半年内）也不会开始训练。
quote_en: We are not currently training GPT-5 and won't for some time.

quote_zh: 我们将在 2023 年 11 月底推出 GPT Store，并与构建最有用、使用最广泛的 GPT 创作者进行收入分成。
quote_en: Next week we are launching the GPT Store... revenue sharing with creators who build the most useful and most used GPTs.

quote_zh: Sora 目前已向红队测试员开放，我们将在今年（2024 年）晚些时候向公众正式开放。
quote_en: Sora is today available to red teamers... we'll make it available to the public later this year.

quote_zh: 我们将在未来几周内（2024 年 6 月底前）向 ChatGPT Plus 用户推出基于 GPT-4o 的新版高级语音模式 Alpha 测试。
quote_en: We'll roll out the new Voice Mode with GPT-4o in alpha within ChatGPT Plus in the coming weeks.

quote_zh: 我们有可能在几千天内（约 2027—2034 年）拥有超级智能（Superintelligence）；也许会更久，但我确信我们会到达那里。
quote_en: It is possible that we will have superintelligence in a few thousand days; it may take longer, but I'm confident we'll get there.

quote_zh: 我们相信在 2025 年，我们可能会看到第一批 AI 智能体「加入劳动力大军」，并实质性改变企业的产出。
quote_en: We believe that, in 2025, we may see the first AI agents 'join the workforce' and materially change the output of companies.

quote_zh: 我们现在确信已经知道如何构建传统意义上理解的 AGI，并在 2025 年交付下一代前沿系统。
quote_en: We are now confident we know how to build AGI as we have traditionally understood it.

quote_zh: 我们将在接下来几周内（2025 年 3 月底前）发布内部代号为 Orion 的 GPT-4.5，作为我们最后一个非思维链模型。
quote_en: We will next ship GPT-4.5, the model we called Orion internally, as our last non-chain-of-thought model, within weeks.

quote_zh: 在 GPT-4.5 之后，我们将在数月内（2025 年内）发布整合了 o 系列推理与 GPT 系列能力的统一模型 GPT-5，并对免费用户开放标准智能。
quote_en: After that, a top goal for us is to unify o-series models and GPT-series models by creating systems that can use all our tools... we will release GPT-5 in months.

quote_zh: 我们计划在未来几个月内（2025 年夏季前）发布自 GPT-2 以来的首个具备推理能力的开放权重（Open-Weight）语言模型。
quote_en: We plan to release our first open-weight language model since GPT-2 with reasoning capabilities in the coming months.

quote_zh: 我们应该能在三年内实现 90% 的行驶里程（自动驾驶）。
quote_en: We should be able to do 90 percent of miles driven [autonomously] within three years.

quote_zh: 明年的特斯拉大概能具备 90% 的自动驾驶能力，即 90% 的里程可以自动行驶，高速公路肯定可以。
quote_en: A Tesla car next year will probably be 90-percent capable of autopilot. Like, so 90 percent of your miles can be on auto. For sure highway travel.

quote_zh: 从技术角度看，特斯拉将在大约三年内（也许更早）拥有能完全自动驾驶的汽车。
quote_en: From a technology standpoint, Tesla will have a car that can do full autonomy in about three years, maybe a bit sooner.

quote_zh: 我们最终会实现完全自动驾驶，我认为大约两年内就能实现。
quote_en: We're going to end up with complete autonomy, and I think we will have complete autonomy in approximately two years.

quote_zh: 我认为两年内，你可以从全国另一端召唤你的车。它会到你手机所在的地方找你……并在整个旅途中自动充电。
quote_en: I think that within two years, you'll be able to summon your car from across the country. It will meet you wherever your phone is … and it will just automatically charge itself along the entire journey.

quote_zh: 我们的目标是……在明年底前完成一次从洛杉矶到纽约的全自动驾驶演示：从洛杉矶的家出发，把你送到纽约时代广场，然后车自己去停车，全程无需任何触碰，包括充电。
quote_en: Our goal is ... that we'll be able to do a demonstration drive of full autonomy all the way from LA to New York, from home in LA to let's say dropping you off in Times Square in New York, and then having the car go park itself, by the end of next year. Without the need for a single touch, including the charger.

quote_zh: 我认为大约两年后（驾驶员就可以在车上睡觉）。
quote_en: I think [a driver will be able to sleep at the wheel in] about two years.

quote_zh: 我认为今年就能实现全自动驾驶功能完备，即车能在停车场找到你、接上你并无需干预地把你送到目的地。我可以说我对此确定，这不是问号。
quote_en: I think we will be feature complete — full self-driving — this year, meaning the car will be able to find you in a parking lot, pick you up and take you all the way to your destination without an intervention, this year. I would say I am of certain of that. That is not a question mark.

quote_zh: 我非常有信心地预测，明年会有特斯拉的自动驾驶出租车——不是在所有地区，因为不是所有地方都会获得监管批准……明年肯定会有超过一百万辆 Robotaxi 上路。
quote_en: I feel very confident predicting that there will be autonomous robotaxis from Tesla next year — not in all jurisdictions because we won't have regulatory approval everywhere. ... next year for sure, we'll have over a million robotaxis on the road.

quote_zh: 我仍然有信心今年完成 L5 级自动驾驶的基本功能。
quote_en: I remain confident that we will have the basic functionality for level five autonomy complete this year.

quote_zh: 我非常有信心今年汽车自动驾驶的可靠性将超过人类。
quote_en: I'm highly confident the car will drive itself for the reliability in excess of a human this year.

quote_zh: 我关注的两项技术，理想情况下希望年底前完成：让星舰进入轨道……以及让特斯拉汽车实现自动驾驶……至少在美国广泛发布自动驾驶，并可能在欧洲（视监管批准而定）。
quote_en: The two technologies I am focused on, trying to ideally get done before the end of the year, are getting our Starship into orbit ... and then having Tesla cars to be able to do self-driving. ... Have self-driving in wide release at least in the U.S., and ... potentially in Europe, depending on regulatory approval.

quote_zh: 我认为今年晚些时候我们将实现全自动驾驶，也许就是你们所说的 L4 或 L5。
quote_en: I think we'll achieve full self-driving, maybe what you would call four or five, I think later this year.

quote_zh: 我们将于 6 月在奥斯汀推出无监督 FSD 付费服务。
quote_en: We're going to be launching unsupervised Full Self-Driving as a paid service in Austin in June.

quote_zh: 第一辆从工厂产线末端自行开到客户家中的特斯拉将在 6 月 28 日。
quote_en: First Tesla that drives itself from factory end of line all the way to a customer house is June 28.

quote_zh: 真正的考验是：你能否在车里睡着、醒来已到目的地。我有信心今年底前这将在美国许多城市实现。
quote_en: The acid test is, can you go to sleep in your car and wake up in your destination and I'm confident that will be available in many cities in the US by the end of this year.

quote_zh: 我想到年底，我们可能会在覆盖约一半美国人口的地区提供自动驾驶网约车。这至少是我们的目标，取决于监管批准。
quote_en: I think we'll probably have autonomous ride hailing in probably half the population of the U.S. by the end of the year. That's at least our goal subject to regulatory approvals.

quote_zh: 我认为到今年底，在某些地区（FSD）将可供个人无监督使用。
quote_en: I think [FSD] will be available for unsupervised personal use by the end of this year in certain geographies.

quote_zh: ……然后我们预计 Cybercab 投产，大概——我对时间表往往有点乐观——在 2026 年。
quote_en: ...then we expect to be in production with the CyberCab ... in probably, well, I tend to be a little optimistic with time frames ... but in 2026.

quote_zh: 我们实际上预计明年在德州和加州开始全自动、无监督的 FSD。
quote_en: We do expect actually to start fully autonomous, unsupervised FSD in Texas and California next year.

quote_zh: ……Cybercab 是我们正在制造的特定车型，没有方向盘和踏板……我们预计 4 月开始生产。
quote_en: ...the CyberCab, which is a specific model that we're making, does not have a steering wheel or pedals. ... We expect to start production in April.

quote_zh: 我们预计到年底，在大约四分之一到一半的美国地区实现全自动驾驶车辆（待监管批准）……预计年底前进入几十个主要城市。
quote_en: We expect to have fully autonomous vehicles in probably somewhere between a quarter and half of the United States by the end of the year, pending regulatory approval. ... we expect to be in dozens of major cities by the end of the year.

quote_zh: 我预测明年下半年将有数百万辆特斯拉完全自动驾驶运行。
quote_en: I predict that there will be millions of Teslas operating fully autonomously in the second half of next year.

quote_zh: ……有信心明年人们就能把自己的车加入或移出特斯拉车队。
quote_en: ...confidently next year, people would be able to add or subtract their car to the Tesla, Inc. fleet.

quote_zh: 星舰将于明年底搭载 Optimus 飞往火星。如果着陆顺利，载人着陆最早可能在 2029 年开始，不过 2031 年可能性更大。
quote_en: Starship departs for Mars at the end of next year, carrying Optimus. If those landings go well, then human landings may start as soon as 2029, although 2031 is more likely.

quote_zh: 我认为如果一切按计划进行，我们应该能在 2024 年发射载人飞船，2025 年抵达（火星）。
quote_en: I think, if things go according to plan, we should be able to launch people probably in 2024, with arrival in 2025.

quote_zh: 基本计划是从 2018 年开始，每个火星窗口期都发射一次火星任务。
quote_en: The basic game plan is we're going to send a mission to Mars with every Mars opportunity from 2018 onwards.

quote_zh: 我们希望（理想情况下）在明年底之前将其植入人类患者体内。所以这并不遥远。
quote_en: We hope to have this aspirationally in a human patient before the end of next year. So this is not far.

quote_zh: 内部常规计划是今年生产约 1 万台 Optimus。今年 12 月底能否正好造出 1 万台？可能不行，但能否造出几千台？是的，我认为可以。
quote_en: The normal internal plan calls for roughly 10,000 Optimus robots to be built this year. Will we succeed in building 10,000 exactly by the end of December this year? Probably not, but will we succeed in making several thousand? Yes, I think we will.

quote_zh: 很高兴宣布 Tesla Semi 卡车开始生产，12 月 1 日向 @Pepsi 交付！
quote_en: Excited to announce start of production of Tesla Semi Truck with deliveries to @Pepsi on Dec 1st!
